definitions.explanation: A camera with a single lens system used for both viewing and capturing images, typically with interchangeable lenses. Covers both traditional single-lens reflex (SLR) cameras and modern mirrorless interchangeable-lens cameras.

examples.english: Take photos with a single-lens camera.

notes:
Short for ⟦{一眼|いちがん}→一眼：08955_ichigan⟧レフカメラ (single-lens reflex camera), though in modern usage it also encompasses mirrorless cameras (⟦ミラーレス→ミラーレス：24424_miraaresu⟧⟦{一眼|いちがん}→一眼：08955_ichigan⟧). The term ⟦{一眼|いちがん}→一眼：08955_ichigan⟧ literally means "one eye" — the single lens is used for both composing and capturing the image, unlike older twin-lens designs.
